entries.activation_restart_boundary: No runtime restart; reconciliation reads repository files.
entries.authority: The canonical Living Diagnostics reconciliation in src/estate/diagnostics/living.py and its accepted implementation baseline.
entries.escalation_condition: A packet is invalid, an implementation change is uncovered, or accepted baseline authority is unavailable.
entries.expected_input: A strict Diagnostic Impact Packet describing repository-relative changed artifacts.
entries.expected_output: Accepted candidate knowledge, affected checkpoint identities, and fail-closed freshness classifications.
known_failures: invalid packet cannot cover changed artifact
likely_causes: changed file omitted from a valid packet
entries.probe_summary: Create a packet, reconcile against the accepted baseline, then inspect affected checkpoints and preserved candidates.
prohibited_actions: Do not advance the accepted baseline to hide staleness
Do not treat local-AI output as promotion authority
entries.purpose: Ingest developer change impact without creating a second reconciliation or checkpoint authority.
entries.recovery_summary: Correct the packet or add missing impact metadata, then rerun canonical reconciliation.
entries.recovery_verification: The packet is consumed, affected checkpoints are reported, and canonical knowledge remains unchanged.
entries.title: Developer Diagnostic Impact Packet ingestion
